page-title.purpose: The app's page heads and the drawer's title.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Confident arrivals: the hero entrance, the plates drawing on, an activity line blurring in, menus and the drawer.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: A thread winding through the first plate (1400ms).

motion.name: ease-slide
motion.purpose: A row changing groups (460ms within a group, 760ms across).

motion.name: ease-quad
motion.purpose: Hover colour and fills: --dur-hover for links and items, --dur-quick for pills.

motion.name: ease-quart
motion.purpose: Controls that move: the hover arrow's shaft and head, a switch's knob (300ms).

motion.name: ease-cubic
motion.purpose: Wipes and flashes: a stalled tint wiping in (500ms), a status circle flashing (900ms), the live ping (2s).

motion.name: dur-hover
motion.purpose: Link, nav item and icon button hover.

motion.name: dur-quick
motion.purpose: Pill fills, focus rings, menus scaling in.

motion.name: dur-move
motion.purpose: The hover arrow, a switch, the lit edge fading on.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0, blur(10px), translateY(20%) to rest; 900ms, 42ms per word after 60ms
motion.purpose: The landing H1 only, word by word on load.

motion.name: rise-soft
motion.value: opacity 0, blur(6px), translateY(8px) to rest; 800ms at 380 to 600ms
motion.purpose: The hero lede, pills, guest line and next-deadline link following the H1.

motion.name: light-up
motion.value: a 400%-wide gradient mask sliding from 150% to 0 with opacity; 1100ms after 300ms
motion.purpose: The hero window coming on, left to right. The mask exists only during the animation.

motion.name: draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 on pathLength 1; 1000ms, 34ms apart (capped at 700ms), 220ms between plates
motion.purpose: The statement band's plates, once, the first time they come into view.

motion.name: status-flash
motion.value: brightness 1.7 and scale 1.22 at 14%, back to rest; 900ms after 380ms, ease-cubic
motion.purpose: The status circle of the row that moved on the sample day.

motion.name: log-in
motion.purpose: The sample window's newest activity line.

motion.name: pop
motion.value: opacity 0, scale(0.96) to rest from the trigger corner; 160ms, ease-out
motion.purpose: Menus.

motion.name: slide
motion.value: translateX(30px), opacity 0, clip-path inset(0 0 0 30%) to rest; 360ms, ease-out
motion.purpose: The thread drawer.

motion.name: tint-wipe
motion.purpose: The red tint behind a silence count crossing the limit.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: The priority glyph when a priority is set.

motion.name: print
motion.value: 26ms per character by default, one shared loop
motion.purpose: A printed field retyping left to right: counts, clocks, faces, status words.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.value: a 200% background highlight sweeping across clipped text; 2.2s linear, infinite
motion.purpose: Only on text waiting on GitHub; settles to plain text when motion is off.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms, delays 0s, one iteration
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion or html[data-motion="off"]: everything lands at once.

narrative.overview:
Spool is a quiet dark workspace built at Linear's craft, paced like Stripe and framed the way Cursor mounts its product: a near-black console, grey steps, white-alpha hairlines and Inter set tight. Every open thread a contributor has on GitHub is one row, grouped by the question the product exists to answer: whose move is it. The landing page proves that by playing a real-scale Spool window through a sample day on a toned stage; the app is that same window at full size, a sidebar beside one inset panel.

The register is calm and precise, not decorative. Surfaces separate by a step in grey and a 1px rule, never by texture. Colour lives only in marks: the yellow half circle for your move, the red square for silence past the limit, a kind dot in a label, the indigo of something new or acted on. Every action is a pill, light for the one main way in and quiet beside it, and every arrow on an action is the same chevron that grows a shaft on hover. Figures are set inline as count lines, never as stat cards. Dark is the default; light is one switch away and keeps every structure.

Motion has one authored entrance and is otherwise driven by the scroll. The hero headline rises word by word out of a blur while its window lights up under a sweeping mask, and the sample day plays on its own clock because it is the first screen. Everything after it moves with the page: the statement band's plates draw on and act out their idea as they rise, the product tour pins and plays a morning in the app, the row walkthrough pops out to fill the screen and walks its cards sideways, the field's planes fly while the page moves, the season route draws, and the route diagram's lights travel. Scrolling back plays all of it backwards, and stopping holds it. Beyond that, things move when they change: a row slides between groups and flashes its status circle, numerals retype, a stalled tint wipes in, menus scale in from their trigger. Reduced motion or the motion switch settles all of it at once, delays included, and nothing pins. Four signatures carry over from earlier worlds: the letter-built faces in a chip beside the wordmark, the 3D field where every PR is a flight and the merge is the landing, numerals that retype with an optional printer sound, and the footer strip you can type on.

Confirmed rejections: the dashboard-screenshot hero, bento grids of feature cards, stat-card rows, monospace as costume, gradient text (one narrow exception, below), neon glows, and the paper strips, black holders and airport costume of the earlier worlds.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black console, three grey surface steps and a picked step, 1px white-alpha rules between everything.
Colour only in marks: yellow for your move, red for stalled silence, indigo for new or acted on, kind dots in label pills.
Linear-style status circles and a fixed priority slot at the start of every row; silence at the end.
Every action a pill with the hover arrow; figures as inline count lines.
Inter 510 set tight for heads, Ink Soft as the second voice, Geist Mono only for tags, codes and printed data.
One authored entrance; after the hero, motion follows the scroll, and otherwise things move only when state changes.

rules.name: The Small Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour lives in marks: a status circle, a dot, a lamp, a tinted count, a thin bar. If a whole button, card or panel turns a status colour, it is wrong. The only filled light surface is the primary pill.

rules.name: The Four Jobs Rule
rules.body: Indigo means new to you or acted on. Yellow means the move is yours. Red means silence past the limit and nothing else. Alert carries problems. They never trade jobs.

rules.name: The Second Voice Rule
rules.body: A section head's lede is Ink Soft: a step under the title, well above the notes. Sub-heads inside a section drop to Ink 2, and the app's page ledes to Ink 3.

rules.name: The Quiet Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono sets codes, captions and the data the printer retypes (faces, a clock, days left, stars, a limit, a phase word), never a heading, a button or a sentence. Counts in heads, rows and the app's figure lines are Inter with tabular figures, even while they retype.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Status words read in sentence case with their abbreviations spelled out ("CI failing", "Changes requested", "Incoming PR", "With the author"). Only mono tags and printed fields are capitals.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: A raised thing is lit along its top edge by a 1px inset highlight of 6 to 9% ink: the quiet pill, the hero stage, the sample window, the drawer. On fine pointers, the hero window and the section panels also brighten their hairline where the pointer is (a 240px radial light masked to the 1px rim). It is light on a rim, never a glow or a halo.

rules.name: The Glass For Scrolling Rule
rules.body: Translucent glass with a 20px blur is for chrome that content scrolls under: the fixed site nav and the app's phone bar. Nowhere else.

dos: Do put every thread in a row: status circle first, silence last, with the priority slot and the ID column at fixed widths so titles line up.
Do say whose move it is with the group and the status circle.
Do make every action a pill: the light pill for the one main way in, quiet pills beside it, every arrow the hover arrow.
Do keep surfaces neutral and let marks carry the colour.
Do set figures as inline count lines or as tabs and toggles with counts.
Do open landing sections with a hairline and a title-left, lede-right head, the lede in Ink Soft.
Do label synthetic data SAMPLE DATA and live data LIVE in mono caption tags; in the app, one quiet band across the panel's top.
Do write status words in sentence case with abbreviations spelled out.
Do step secondary text up to Ink 2 on Bay 3 and Surface Sel, where Ink 3 falls under 4.5:1.
Do settle every motion at once, delays included, under reduced motion or the motion switch.
donts: Don't fill a button, card or panel with a status colour; problems get Alert text on a faint wash, never a red fill.
Don't use Stalled Red for anything but silence past the limit; errors and refusals use Alert.
Don't build a stat-card row, a bento of feature cards or a dashboard-screenshot hero.
Don't set headings, buttons or prose in mono.
Don't use gradient text, glows or texture; the shimmer on text waiting on GitHub is the one gradient text.
Don't give every section an entrance: the hero has one, the plates draw once, and everything else moves only when its state changes.
Don't box sections again inside the app's inset panel.
Don't add a second 3D scene or put planes outside the field.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading, or number the sections.
